acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Great Cats family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Wildcat, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Brush-Pounce Initiate archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Lean tawny wildcat with long tail, tufted ears, light spotting, and small but readable claws.
Signature mechanic: Nearest-Cover Pounce: the Wildcat always uses the closest valid low cover after breaking sight.
battlefieldDuty: Break line of sight once and pounce from the nearest low cover.
constructionDimensions: Streaming wet fur, reflective whiskers, coherent droplets, and visible muscle beneath saturated coat preserve the feline body.
Narrow water wakes follow pounces and territory lanes, with pressure gathering at paws and jaw before release.
counterplay: Face the opening or step toward it to force an early short pounce, then punish the landing. Affinity signal: The loaded paw or jaw channel drains after the attack and reveals the ordinary landing or pin window.
forbiddenTreatments: Splash that obscures eye line, claws, or tail direction
identityInvariants: Every form retains a four-legged feline body, flexible spine, retractile claws, whiskered muzzle, mobile ears, and expressive tail.
Species variation remains feline and is communicated by coat pattern, limb proportion, mane, canine length, and hunting posture rather than equipment.
Eye line, tail stillness, shoulder compression, cover disturbance, and landing posture preserve readable attack direction.
telegraph: Its tail tip stops and the chosen cover edge parts immediately before launch.
